basics.name: Junteng Liu
basics.label: Ph.D. Candidate @ HKUST NLP
basics.summary: First-year PhD candidate at HKUST NLP Group researching natural language processing and machine learning, with research interests in LLM reasoning and reinforcement learning, hallucination in vision-language models, and LLM truthfulness and interpretability.

work.summary: Research internship at Shanghai AI Lab.
